descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S04 Generate with no pre-round today still creates the entry, in both contexts (live AI)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note. (TFA-92589 AC 2; TFA-92589 description 1)
  • U4 Nursing Home: entries are keyed by visit number and labelled 'Visit N – date'. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 5)
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fixture Hospital patient and resident, no pre-round today and no course line yet

When Open Encounter, type the visit text, tap Generate Note & Finish, wait for the note, open Pre-Round; do it in Hospital, then in Nursing Home

Then Hospital Course shows exactly one card dated today, carrying a fact said only at the encounter. Nursing Home shows 'Visit 1 – <today>' once, from the note (the 2026-10-02 audit found that a direct Generate missed the Visit prefix)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs, scoped to the Course Timeline / Visit Timeline: Hospital '{day0}:' once, an encounter fact present, no 'Encounter done'; NH 'Visit 1 – {day0}' once, an encounter fact present, no 'Visit 2 –', no 'Encounter done'. The carry-forward card's '{day0}:' line is outside the scope and only recorded. …
